skills.name: code-organizer
skills.description: Reorder code without changing logic in React / TypeScript projects — sorts import statements into layered groups and arranges hooks, state, refs, memos and effects inside components and custom hooks. Use when asked to "organize imports", "sort imports", "reorder hooks", "tidy component structure", or when invoking /code-organizer explicitly.
skills.description_zh: 在React或TypeScript中仅重排代码结构，不改变逻辑，分层整理导入并排列组件或自定义钩子的状态、引用、memo和effect。

skills.name: fowler-refactor
skills.description: Analyze code using Martin Fowler's refactoring catalog (Extract Function, Decompose Conditional, Replace Conditional with Lookup Table, Split Phase, etc.) and propose safe, backward-compatible improvements via a structured interview. Use when asked to refactor, improve code structure, remove code smells, introduce indirection layers, or when invoking /fowler-refactor explicitly.
headings: Three Core Axes (resolve all three, then stop asking)
Step 2 — Fowler Pattern Mapping & Proposal Report
skills.description_zh: 依据Martin Fowler重构目录分析代码，经结构化访谈提出安全且向后兼容的函数提取、条件拆分、查表替代与阶段分离等改善。
